name: [ENDLESS] Trespasser
desc:
[PC CONTROLS] - F for Flashlight - Shift for Sprint 

[HOW TO PLAY] 
🧑 Meet your resident quota by allowing people into the building whilst disallowing anomalies. 
😈 Identify anomalies by odd behavior
🚪 Keep emergency exits shut at all times to prevent unwanted visitors. 
⚡ Make sure the generator always has power. 
📱 In the case of a trespasser, use the emergency phone!
